newsitem.title: USA: Delta, Air Jamaica in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Delta, Air Jamaica in marketing pact.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said Monday it signed a letter of intent with Air Jamaica to pursue joint cooperation in marketing and other services.

The letter of intent could lead to a definitive marketing and business relationship, Delta said. Both airlines could expect expand revenue opportunities while cutting costs through more efficient use of resources, it said.
Delta currently provides A310 aircraft maintenance, flight operations, and related training assistance to the Jamaican carrier.

The carriers "could visualize" a pact with cooperation in: schedule coordination, for easier connections between the two carriers; better computer reservations systems; sharing facilities and passenger handling in jointly-served cities; and mutual participation in each airline's frequent flyer program, Delta said.
